activity.notes: Frederick received the Italian royal crown in 1155 and retained that crown until his death in 1190. Production already models the Kingdom of Italy as a distinct polity for medieval and later rulers, so this Activity restores a separate crown that the legacy Holy Roman Empire 'King and emperor' row omitted.

sources.title: Federico I di Svevia detto il Barbarossa — Treccani, Dizionario di Storia
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Frederick's election as German king in 1152, his coronation as King of Italy in 1155, and his subsequent imperial coronation.

sources.title: Inauguration and political liturgy in the Hohenstaufen Empire, 1138–1215 — German History
sources.citation_text: The study explains the multiple royal and imperial inaugurations attached to rulers of the Hohenstaufen Empire.
